offers.title: Edge Data Processing and Software Engineer
offers.description:
VITO develops technology to facilitate the transition to a more sustainable society and economy. One of the key technologies applied in this context is Remote Sensing. The Remote Sensing Unit of VITO celebrated last year its 25th anniversary, but Remote Sensing has never been more fascinating than today. With the increasing number of satellites, drones, processing facilities and technologies like artificial intelligence, the opportunities with remote sensing are larger than ever.

Meet the team:

The Applied GeoAI and Embedded Solutions (AGES) team develops robust AI-driven solutions that power remote sensing, environmental monitoring, and security applications worldwide.

offers.requirements:
• Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Space Systems Engineering or a related field.

  • Experience with data science, machine learning, image processing or scientific data processing through work, research or academic projects.

  • Proven track record of building maintainable and testable software for embedded systems.

  • Good knowledge and strong interest in keeping up-to-date with embedded compute architectures (GPU/TPU/SoC).

  • Team player, strong analytical and problem-solving skills and an eagerness to learn.

  • Excellent command of English; Dutch is a plus.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Satellite, drone or airborne image processing.

  • On-board or edge processing of sensor data.

offers.title: Project Lead – Earth Observation Platforms for Security & Defence
offers.description:
As Project Lead, you will guide the delivery of Earth Observation platform capabilities for security, defense and resilience applications, with a strong focus on European programs such as the European Resilience from Space program and its ground segment.

You will translate needs from Belgian, European and NATO security stakeholders into secure, scalable and operational platform services. Working with researchers, IT architects and software engineers, you will lead projects from proposal to delivery, coordinate partners and help shape a roadmap for dual-use Earth Observation services that support rapid access to reliable data, analytics and decision-ready information.
